# To The Max

> To The Max is a one-operator marketing agency in Huntsville, Alabama that runs paid ads, landing pages, lead capture, and follow-up for local service businesses, and tests every strategy on the founder's own company before selling it.

## What the agency does

To The Max acts as a full marketing department for local businesses. Services: paid advertising on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), landing page and website design, lead capture forms and follow-up systems, and content and creative production. Services ship as one connected system because an ad without a converting page and fast follow-up wastes budget.

The agency's defining practice: the founder, Maximus Fayrweather, owns Supreme Clean, a pressure washing company in Huntsville doing five thousand dollars a month in revenue. Advertising strategies are funded with his own money on that business first. Results, wins and failures alike, are recorded with dates in a public record called the Ledger at /proof.

## Who it works with

Local and owner-operated service businesses: home services, trades, artists and studios, and other companies that win work in their own city. Current documented work includes a pressure washing company (the founder's own) and Sophi Paints, a commissioned-art studio whose full funnel and first Meta lead campaign launched July 16, 2026, within two weeks of signing.

## How engagements work

Engagements start with a fifteen-minute call or text, no pitch. Clients see the plan in writing, including budget and expected cost per lead, before any spend. Work runs month to month. Clients own every ad account, page, creative asset, and lead from day one. Success is measured in cost per lead and booked work, not impressions.
